title: alchemilla alpestris var. obtusa
intro: Alchemilla alpestris var. obtusa, commonly known as alpine lady's mantle, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including menstrual disorders, inflammation, and digestive problems, thanks to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its ability to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of alpine lady's mantle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
